card.name: Kidney after acute or reduce
card.fires_on: The word kidney (or renal) right after 'acute' or 'reduce', in warnings about acute kidney injury or drugs that reduce renal function.

modes.label: Acute kidney injury
modes.description: The word kidney following 'acute' in volume depletion and kidney injury warnings.
modes.example: Volume Depletion : May result in acute<< kidney>> injury.

modes.label: Reduce renal function
modes.description: The word renal following 'reduce' in drug interaction text about kidney function.
modes.example: with drugs that reduce<< renal>> function or compete for active tubular secretion
